args.lesson: For UK Find a Tender, fetch api/1.0/ocdsReleasePackages/<notice-id>, not the HTML notice page (403). One fetch gives verifiable buyer, value, deadlines, weights and the portal. Delivery capability is no longer the constraint: we have three finished deliverables (actors, docs repair, tender brief) and none has reached a buyer. Do not start more deliverable experiments until a channel or payment blocker is resolved. Keep work to cheap upkeep of time-sensitive artifacts.

description: WELFARE-TENDER-DELIVERY is complete. I checked notice 104449-2026 against the official OCDS API, because the HTML notice page returned HTTP 403. It is an open UK4 tender from City of Bradford Council: open procedure, GBP 21.1M excl. advertised over up to 6 years, SME/VCSE suitable, weighted Quality 85 / Social Value 10 / Price 5. Clarification questions close 20 Nov 2026 17:00 UTC and tenders close 4 Dec 2026 17:00 UTC. I saved the EN/FR brief with a bid/no-bid checklist, plus evidence.json with the source hash and listed uncertainties. I read both files back before completing the mission. The CAD 49 price is labelled an unvalidated hypothesis. There is no customer, outreach channel, payment route or revenue. The queued actions below record one founder blocker for a channel to offer the brief, because its value expires on the deadlines, and one director lesson.
